name: torch-declared-demo
notes: The ADR-0025 declared-model seam: the DOCUMENT names the nn.Module (torch.nn:Linear + its constructor kwargs) — swapping the model is a config edit, never a subclass. The loop knobs beyond the linear demo: adam, weight decay, gradient clipping, and the quantile (pinball) objective at tau 0.5. DeclaredPredict restores the exact fit from the sidecar-verified artifact, cross-checking the declared module.

market.notes: the same synthetic market the torch-linear demo trains on

qhat.notes: tau 0.5 pinball = median regression; per-epoch losses land in trainlog.json beside the model

predict.notes: declaring the module here is a cross-check against the sidecar — a different family refuses by name
